import hashlib,importlib,importlib.util,json,sys,types
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
name="orze.cli_replication"
p=Path("docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-06c-before-cli-replication.py").resolve()
parent_name,leaf=name.rsplit('.',1)
parent=importlib.import_module(parent_name)
original=importlib.import_module(name)
data=p.read_bytes()
replacement=types.ModuleType(name);replacement.__file__=str(p);replacement.__package__=parent_name
replacement.__spec__=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p)
sys.modules[name]=replacement;setattr(parent,leaf,replacement)
exec(compile(data,str(p),'exec'),replacement.__dict__)
assert getattr(parent,leaf) is sys.modules[name] is replacement
print(json.dumps({'mode':'whole_fixed_baseline_module_in_memory','snapshot':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(data),'module':name,'original':original.__file__,'parent_binding_exact':True}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-q','-p','no:cacheprovider','--tb=short',"tests/test_cpu_replication_product.py::test_cpu_replication_cli_accepts_explicitly_absent_training_paths"]))
PY
